data_objects.name: station_daily_max_temperatures
data_objects.meaning: Station-and-date maximum-temperature observations with duplicate date formats and Celsius/Fahrenheit representations.
data_objects.notes: Rows are keyed by station and date rather than by physical row order.

variables.name: datetime
variables.meaning: Observation date encoded compactly as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: obs_type
variables.meaning: Observation-type code; TMAX denotes maximum temperature.

variables.name: TMAX_F
variables.meaning: The same maximum-temperature observation represented in Fahrenheit.

variables.name: datetime_dt
variables.meaning: Observation date encoded in ISO YYYY-MM-DD form.

structure.description: Each row is a maximum-temperature observation for a station-date pair; station plus datetime acts as the candidate key.
datetime and datetime_dt are equivalent date encodings, while obs_value and TMAX_F are Celsius and Fahrenheit encodings of the same measurement.
Physical row order is not chronological; station and date fields provide the grouping and temporal axes.

uncertainties: Station locations, station-network conventions, and the daily observation-window definition are not included.
The table does not state whether the date is local to each station or based on a common time standard.
annotation_notes: Only train.csv was used; the temperature and date equivalences are grounded in the paired source values.
